appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line plot displays the data trend across the years 1880 to 1891.
The line begins at a low vertical position (approx. 1,000) and fluctuates between the 1,000 and 1,600 marks.
The line rises steadily from the 1,500 level to a plateau around the 2,300-2,400 level.
The line reaches its highest vertical point (peak) in 1890, exceeding the 3,500 grid line, before dropping slightly in 1891.
The line shows a clear upward movement from the bottom-left region to the top-right region of the plot area.

printed_facts.fact: The title reads: 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks at 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000, and 3,500.
The axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for each year from 1880 to 1891.
